name: Marathon County, WI
findings: Marathon County has 399 nonprofit organizations. 182 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 147 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Marathon County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 19 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do hobby and sports organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list public events
observations.text: 7 hobby and sports organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for membership
